responsibilities: Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle.
Gather business and system requirements from stakeholders and conduct feasibility studies.
Write well-designed, testable, efficient code with proper coding conventions.
Work with other developers, business analysts, and product owners on technical solutions to business problems.
Able to work independently as well as in a team setting focused on fast-paced application development.
Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives technologies.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Two speed phrases ("fast-paced application development", "fast-paced development environment using Agile") against one quality phrase ("testable, efficient code") meet the two-to-one tie-breaker, so velocity.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The posting names no industry, client or financial or regulatory consequence, so moderate by default.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Work with other developers, business analysts, and product owners
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Tools appear only in the requirements; the role joins existing developers and analysts, so mid by default rather than on a strong signal.
evidence.jd_authorship: Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The responsibilities are generic software-developer boilerplate that never mention Power BI or any data domain, so recruiter.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Work with other developers, business analysts, and product owners on technical solutions to business problems.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The only named partners are developers, business analysts and product owners, and no business function is named, so internal_data on weak evidence.
evidence.autonomy_level: Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The verbs are contribute, support and work with, so execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tools or AI-facing data work appear in the posting.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testable code is mentioned as a coding attribute, with no data quality or testing practice the candidate owns, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The posting has no reliability, accuracy or compliance language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New solution design sits alongside continuous improvement of existing work, so mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: Compliance with in-office attendance as business needs dictate is required
evidence.work_arrangement_explanation: In-office attendance is required with no remote allowance stated, so onsite; the "as business needs dictate" wording leaves room for a hybrid pattern.
ats_keywords: Star Schema, Fact and Dimension tables
